name: ponytail-beck-tdd
description: An explicitly selected Kent Beck TDD workflow with Ponytail's maintainable implementation principles.

interface.shortDescription: 켄트 벡의 TDD와 Ponytail로 명시적으로 선택하는 개발 절차
interface.longDescription: When explicitly requested, develop one failing test at a time, implement the minimum change, tidy structure while tests pass, and compose focused tests with necessary integration checks. Grounded in six Kent Beck essays and self-contained Ponytail implementation principles. No automatic deletion of small tests, additional runtime, or global instruction changes.
defaultPrompt: $ponytail-beck-tdd로 요청한 변경을 한 번에 하나의 실패 테스트, 최소 구현, 구조 정리 순서로 완성해주세요.
